label: С
description: Motion away from a place or person, plus 'with' as a companion relation.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Companion relation. 1. 'С тобой' means with you. 2. The phrase is short and extremely common. 3. It’s a core building block for real conversation.
Strategic focus: Motion with a companion. 1. 'С тобой' keeps the companion relation clear. 2. 'Иду' is walking motion. 3. This sentence pairs movement with togetherness.
Strategic focus: Coming from a place. 1. 'С работы' marks departure from work. 2. 'Пришел' is completed motion. 3. This is one of the most natural everyday patterns.
Strategic focus: Ongoing departure. 1. 'С работы' is the source. 2. 'Идет' is present motion. 3. This sentence is the ongoing counterpart to 'пришел с работы'.
Strategic focus: Return from a source. 1. 'С моря' marks the place you came back from. 2. 'Вернулись' is plural completed motion. 3. This is a common travel-memory sentence.
Strategic focus: Leaving a station. 1. 'С вокзала' marks the source. 2. 'Идем' is plural walking motion. 3. The sentence pairs nicely with 'мы идем на вокзал'.
Strategic focus: Removing something from a surface. 1. 'С полки' marks the source. 2. 'Взяла' is completed past tense. 3. This sentence is a strong source contrast with 'на полке'.
Strategic focus: Ongoing removal from a surface. 1. 'С полки' marks the source. 2. 'Беру' is present tense. 3. This sentence is practical and easy to picture.
Strategic focus: Removing from a surface. 1. 'Со стены' marks the source. 2. 'Сняли' is a completed action. 3. The sentence is vivid and useful for household description.
Strategic focus: Ongoing removal from a surface. 1. 'Со стены' is the source. 2. 'Снимаю' is present tense. 3. This is the ongoing counterpart to the completed version.
Strategic focus: Leaving a place. 1. 'С улицы' marks the source. 2. 'Ушел' is completed motion. 3. This sentence is useful for street and location contrasts.
Strategic focus: Ongoing departure from a place. 1. 'С улицы' marks the source. 2. 'Идет' is present tense motion. 3. This sentence reinforces the exit idea.
Strategic focus: Companion relation. 1. 'С другом' means with a friend. 2. 'Пришел' is completed motion. 3. The sentence teaches the companion use of 'с'.
Strategic focus: Motion with a companion. 1. 'С другом' keeps the companion relation clear. 2. 'Идем' is plural walking motion. 3. This sentence is a useful conversational everyday phrase.
Strategic focus: Exit from work. 1. 'С работы' marks departure. 2. 'Вышла' is a completed motion verb. 3. This is an extremely common Russian daily-life pattern.
Strategic focus: Leaving class. 1. 'С урока' marks the source. 2. 'Иду' is present tense motion. 3. The sentence fits school life very naturally.
Strategic focus: Completed departure from class. 1. 'Вышли' is plural past motion. 2. 'С урока' marks the source. 3. This is a perfect contrast to 'идем с урока'.
Strategic focus: Coming together with someone. 1. 'С ним' is the companion form. 2. 'Пришел' is completed motion. 3. This is a useful relation phrase in conversation.
Strategic focus: Living with someone. 1. 'С родителями' is a stable companion relation. 2. 'Живут' is plural present. 3. This sentence is great for everyday family context.

missions.phrase: я ушел с ним из дома
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Complex departure with companion and source. 1. 'С ним' marks the companion. 2. 'Из дома' marks the source. 3. This sentence combines two major movement ideas in one clean line.
